Pulse for 15 October 2026

The stories from 15 October 2026 in the Pulse of the Sapaude app, in our own words. Terms you don’t know are explained in the glossary. Glossary

Everyday tool

ChatGPT can use your tabs

A browser extension is a small add-on that lets a website or app work inside your browser, and ChatGPT’s Chrome extension can now read your open tabs and, in ChatGPT Work, control them to fill forms or send messages after you approve.

Everyday tool

Claude checks PRs for bugs

Code review is the step where someone checks a code change before it goes live, and Anthropic’s Code Review for Claude now does that automatically on GitHub pull requests for Team and Enterprise plans.

Everyday tool

Opus replies 2.5x faster

Fast mode is a paid speed switch on the same model, and Anthropic now lets any Claude API customer turn it on for Claude Opus 5.5 without a waitlist or beta header.

Everyday tool

ChatGPT gets German voices

Full-duplex voice means the AI can listen and speak at the same time, and OpenAI is rolling out GPT-Live-1.1 in ChatGPT Voice with new voices that include German options such as Sonna and Miko.

New model

Smart AI fits on your phone

Ternary Bonsai 2 is a family of small, free AI models from the startup PrismML that are compressed so tightly they can run directly on a phone, laptop or other everyday device.

New model

Meta gives away a top AI

Muse Spark Open is a large AI model from Meta whose weights anyone can download, so companies and developers can run it on their own computers instead of only renting it through an app.

New model

4K AI images on your own PC

FLUX 3 Image Klein is a new image AI from the German lab Black Forest Labs that you can download and run on your own computer to create and edit pictures, even in 4K.

Everyday tool

Make 30-second AI videos

Kling is an AI video generator from the Chinese tech company Kuaishou that turns text, images and other references into short video clips, and its new version 4.0 is now open to everyone.

New model

Open agents see docs too

An open-weight model is a model you can download and run yourself, and NVIDIA's new Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is built so one model can read text, documents, images, and video while calling tools for agent work.

Everyday tool

One AI cart for all stores

Universal Cart is a shopping cart inside Google Search and the Gemini app that collects products from many different online stores in one place and watches their prices for you.

Everyday tool

AI fixes your code alerts

Agentic autofix is a GitHub feature that lets Copilot investigate a security alert, propose a fix, re-check it with CodeQL, and open a draft pull request for you to review.
